column1: # manifests/diag-busybox.tsv -- origin pin of the installer's diagnostic static busybox.
# assets/diag/busybox-<arch> is usr/bin/busybox from Debian forky busybox-static at the pinned
# snapshot, unmodified (preseed/diag-console.sh, build/iso/stage-ncz-payload.py, and the amd64
# verifies the committed binaries offline; --fetch rebuilds them from the deb (sha256-checked, and
# provenance-checked against the signed snapshot index with --index-dir); --repin rewrites this
# file from a verified snapshot index. Source: https://snapshot.debian.org/package/busybox/
# Columns (TAB): arch, package, version, deb_sha256, deb_size, snapshot, dest, sha256, size
